title: Outline does not move things
summary: A hover border pushes its neighbours; an outline (or a ring shadow) draws without taking space.
explanation: A border is part of the box, so adding a 3px border on hover makes the box 6px bigger and shoves everything after it. Hover the first row: the tags jump.
outline is drawn outside the box and takes no space at all, so the second row stays perfectly still. Outlines follow border-radius in modern browsers.
If you do want a border on hover, reserve the space: give the normal state a transparent border of the same width, as the third row does, and only change its colour.
tryThis: Hover a tag in each row and compare.
Change the outline width to 6px in the second row: still no movement.
Remove border: 3px solid transparent from .reserved: it jumps like the first row.
